title: Folder-per-ticket — ticket + plan + evidence
acceptance_criteria: Convention: `backlog/tickets/CM-n-slug/` with `README.md` (ticket body, required) + optional `plan.md` + optional `evidence.md`
All existing flat tickets migrated `CM-n-slug.md` → `CM-n-slug/README.md` via `git mv` (history preserved)
Authoring tools updated: `/start-ticket`, `new-ticket` skill, `/spec` reference the folder path; `next-number.sh` / `roadmap_stats.py` / `check_links.py` confirmed unaffected
`plan.md` + `evidence.md` templates added; evidence policy = pointers (CI run, PR, test names) + small text only, **no committed binaries**
`backlog/README.md` documents the folder layout + plan/evidence; this ticket dogfoods it (its own `plan.md` + `evidence.md`)
CI ladder green (esp. markdown-links across moved files)
goal: Evolve the ticket model from a single markdown file to a folder per ticket holding the ticket body, an optional implementation plan, and optional pointer-based evidence of done.
verification: `sh scripts/ci.sh` green; `next-number.sh` still returns the right next id; ticket folders render on GitHub. See `evidence.md`.
notes: Brownfield change to our own tooling — blast radius mapped first (only the 3 authoring prose refs touch the path; tickets have no relative/inbound links, so the move is safe). `examples/etikets/` tickets + the site greenfield doc to follow in a separate ticket (don't entangle two migrations).
